source.name: kb curated topic map
source.note: Topic map for building LLM systems; lessons and design problems come later.

topics.name: Tokens & embeddings
topics.usage: How text becomes tokens and vectors; context windows, cost per token, similarity.

topics.name: Transformers & LLMs
topics.usage: Attention, decoder-only models, sampling (temperature, top-p) and why outputs vary.

topics.name: Prompting & structured output
topics.usage: Instructions, few-shot examples, tool schemas and JSON output that downstream code can trust.

topics.name: Vector search
topics.usage: Chunk, embed, index (HNSW/IVF) and retrieve by similarity; hybrid with keyword search.

topics.name: Retrieval-augmented generation
topics.usage: Ground answers in retrieved documents: ingestion, retrieval, re-ranking, citations, freshness.

topics.name: Fine-tuning & adaptation
topics.usage: When prompting and RAG aren't enough: SFT, LoRA, preference tuning, and the data they need.

topics.name: Agents & tool use
topics.usage: The model calls tools in a loop: planning, tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop, failure handling.

topics.name: Evaluation
topics.usage: Golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites and online metrics: know if a change made it better.

topics.name: Inference & serving
topics.usage: Batching, KV cache, quantisation, streaming, GPU capacity and routing between models.

topics.name: Guardrails & safety
topics.usage: Input/output filtering, prompt-injection defence, PII handling and policy enforcement.

topics.name: Cost & latency
topics.usage: Token budgets, caching (prompt and semantic), model cascades and time-to-first-token.
